name: Signal / Spatial Journey
displayName: 信号旅程 · 空间讲解
description: 原创空间路径、分层节点、三路探索与汇合；通过镜头深度和沿线消息运动讲清抽象关系。

canvas.adaptation: Reference composition; reflow freely for 9:16 or 1:1. Not an automatic aspect converter.

audio.note: Silent concept preview. Narration, character, voice, language and speaking rate remain user-controlled.

dependencies.fonts: Operating-system Arial/Georgia/monospace; none bundled or fetched. Font metrics can vary across systems.

variants.name: 空间飞行
variants.recipe: Projected layered planes, depth-separated branches, camera push and focus hierarchy. Every state is a pure function of seconds.

variants.name: 平面路线图
variants.recipe: Orthographic branch map removes z projection and perspective size changes for clearer route comparison. Same narrative, different functional geometry.

usage.remix: Reuse projection, paths, message token or plane texture independently; freely rewrite node positions, text and duration. No mandatory template or persona.
usage.avoid: Illustrative relationship metaphor only. Not a real network architecture, protocol, packet reassembly or quantitative dataset.
usage.motion: 0–2.5s launch; 2.5–5.1s three branches and focus; 5.1–8s regroup; 8–10.1s onward arrival; 10.1–12s stable hold.
usage.portrait: Recompose start and destination vertically; keep the branches in three columns. Do not crop the landscape diagram.
usage.captions: Reserve a separate caption region and reflow the scene around it. The sample explanatory footer is not a subtitle track.

provenance.scope: All pack HTML, CSS, JS and four SVG assets; original 3D point projection and branch geometry. Shared helper authored for this repository.
